Subject: Follow-up & next steps — EU data residency / export controls

Hi Sofia / Martin,

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion on your platform requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Summary from the call:
- Requirement: EU data residency for customer data and logs (primary concern is processing in EU regions).
- Compliance: You asked about SOC 2 status, HIPAA posture, and whether we can support contractual controls (DPA / SCCs).
- Export controls: You asked about cross-border transfer risk (OFAC/ITAR) and whether Redwood hosts any export-controlled data by default.

What we’ll provide: 
1) Internal docs: SOC 2 Type II (redacted) and our security overview (attached).
2) Legal: Standard DPA + SCCs template; we can surface any specific contractual language if required.
3) Technical: Confirmation on EU region availability and how we isolate customer data to EU regions (details below).
4) Vendor questionnaire: We’ll send a completed vendor security questionnaire and a blank copy for your team to use.

Quick technical notes (high level):
- EU region: We run production inference endpoints in eu-central-1 and europe-west-1 (region depends on deployment). Customers can pin workloads to those regions and we can restrict storage/metrics to EU.
- Cross-border transfers: By default, customer data processed in the pinned region; backups and metadata replication are configurable — we’ll confirm your desired retention and replication settings in the security call.
- OFAC/ITAR: Redwood does not ingest export-controlled datasets on behalf of customers unless explicitly agreed in writing. For regulated export controls we require a security/contractual assessment and may require private deployment or dedicated tenancy.

Next steps (proposed):
- I’ll attach the SOC 2 redacted report and security overview to this thread (attached).
- Ethan (copied) can follow up with a brief tech note and a proposed config for EU-only residency.
- Monica (copied, legal) will share the DPA + SCCs and the Vendor Security Questionnaire.
- Can we schedule a 45-min security call next week? Suggest Tue 2026-12-08 10:00–10:45 CET or Wed 2026-12-09 14:00–14:45 CET.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf, SOC2_Type2_Redacted.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

Hi Martin / Sofia — quick technical follow-up from our infra/security team: 

1) EU residency guarantee: For pinned EU deployments we support a configuration that keeps inference, model artifacts, logs, and audit trails within selected EU regions. We can disable any US-based analytics/telemetry and route metrics to an EU tenant. That configuration is part of our Dedicated and Private offers; for hosted customers we offer region pinning with contractual guarantees in the DPA/SCCs.

2) Replication & backups: Backups are region-scoped by default; cross-region replication is opt-in. We’ll document the retention windows and provide a recommended config for your pilot (e.g., logs retained 90 days in EU only).

3) SOC 2 status: Marissa attached the redacted Type II. Our most recent SOC 2 Type II covers the period 2025-09-01 through 2026-08-31. We can provide a scoped upload to your procurement portal or an on-demand attestation.

4) OFAC / ITAR: We do not process ITAR-controlled datasets on our shared hosted tier. For customers needing to process export-controlled data we recommend Dedicated tenancy or Private deployment (VPC/on-prem). Estimated uplift: 25–40% over hosted pricing depending on isolation level and support. This is negotiable for enterprise contracts.

5) KMS & keys: We support customer-managed keys (KMS) in EU for Private/Dedicated; logs and backups can be encrypted with customer keys.

I’ll attach a short configuration checklist for an EU-only deployment and can jump on the security call to walk through specifics.

Thanks,
Ethan Park
Security Engineer, Infra | Redwood Inference
